stories.text: 🔮 PROJECTION FLIP: The Mahomies is now projected to beat Kyle Tucker.
🚨 MEDIAN FLIP: Kyle Tucker just moved below the projected league median.
🚨 RULED OUT: K. Monangai won't play, and he's in Mr. Action Jackson's starting lineup. Kickoff's Thursday 8:15 PM. Clock's ticking.
🪦 FRESH OBITUARY: Moose Knucklers has been laid to rest (15.79 pts short). Read it on the Death Watch tab, and bring tissues.
🗑️ DROP REGRET: Drake Maye averaged 7.5 before 49er Faith-Fool cut him in Week 4. Since: 30.1 a week. Now he's helping Brock You Like a Hurricane.
🏟️ Game to watch: NE @ CHI (Thursday 8:15 PM), 14 league starters in action with 143.75 pts up for grabs.
📺 Up next, Thursday 8:15 PM (NE @ CHI): 14 league starters in action. Most riding on it: Ruffing the Passer vs Gibb it to Me Baby (38.24 pts projected).
🔁 In hindsight: If TDsMaGee and Claremont In Yo Stace! had swapped Robinson and Williams for LaPorta and London back in Week 1, both would be ahead.
🗑️ BARGAIN BIN: The Mahomies (5-7)'s healthy bench averages 15% rostered across ESPN, plus 1 injured bench spot and 2 defenses.
🎤 BYE BYE BYE: Kirbo Crushers has 2 starters on bye this week (McConkey and Jaguars D/ST). Time to work the waiver wire.
🧾 Wednesday waivers are in: 3 claims went through. Top prize: Will Reichard (K, proj 11.55 pts) to 49er Faith-Fool, who cut Eddy Pineiro to make room.
🗞️ Fresh off the wire: 49er Faith-Fool added Hunter Henry (TE, projected 8.20 pts), plus 2 more pickups.
📈 49er Faith-Fool was down to 19% against Claremont In Yo Stace! — and won.
